content.user_title: Generate Cohesive AI Videos from Any Brief
content.value_statement: Creating consistent AI video across multiple clips requires careful planning and model selection. This skill coordinates prompts, references, generation, and stitching.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes supplied images and videos before planning generation.
Selects a supported video model based on the requested outcome.
Creates one continuous clip from text, images, video, or audio references.
Plans multi-clip stories with reusable references for visual continuity.
Tracks pending generation jobs and stitches completed clips in order.
Handles aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and audio settings.
limitations: Requires compatible video generation, analysis, and stitching tools.
Generated continuity depends on model quality and clear reference media.
Some models do not support every media mode, duration, or aspect ratio.
Generation can incur provider costs and may return pending jobs.

use_cases.title: Create Social Videos
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign brief and product images into a formatted short video.

use_cases.title: Animate Creative Assets
use_cases.description: Bring a still image to life while preserving its subject and composition.

use_cases.title: Produce Multi-Clip Stories
use_cases.description: Plan recurring subjects, generate connected scenes, and join them into one video.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] video of [subject and action] in [setting], formatted for [destination].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one text-to-video clip.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Still Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image for [duration]. Preserve [subject details], add [motion], and deliver it in [aspect ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user has one starting image.

prompt_templates.title: Use Reference Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a video using [media] for [motion, style, or timing]. Keep [elements] and change [elements].
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator provides image, video, or audio references.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Clip Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a [total duration] story about [concept]. Maintain [recurring subjects] across clips, include [dialogue], and deliver in [format].
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced project needs continuity across several generated clips.

output_examples.input: Animate a product photo into a six-second vertical reveal.
output_examples.output: A vertical video opens on the supplied image, adds a controlled reveal motion, and preserves the product appearance.

output_examples.input: Create a thirty-second story with one presenter across three scenes.
output: An approved concept defines the presenter, setting, script, and three connected scenes.
Three clips reuse the same presenter reference and visual direction.
The completed clips are joined in story order.

best_practices: Provide clear durations, destinations, and aspect ratios.
Use clean reference images for recurring people, products, or props.
Approve the multi-clip concept before starting paid generation.
anti_patterns: Do not combine a start frame with reference media in one request.
Do not restart a pending job because it can create duplicate charges.
Do not regenerate an unsatisfactory clip without user approval.

faq.question: Can it create a video from text only?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan and request a text-to-video clip without reference media.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use the image as a start frame or visual reference.

faq.question: Can it create videos longer than one model clip?
faq.answer: Yes. It divides the story into clips, generates them, and stitches them in order.

faq.question: Does it preserve people and products across scenes?
faq.answer: It reuses reference images and descriptions to improve continuity, but exact consistency is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can it synchronize motion to existing audio?
faq.answer: Yes, when the selected model accepts audio references.

faq.question: Does it generate separate music or voice files?
faq.answer: No. Separate audio assets require a dedicated audio generation workflow.
